sn17.24:1.3: Saddhā bhikkhave upāsikā ekam dhītaraṃ piyaṃ manāpam evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya || ||
sn17.24:1.4: Tādisā āyye bhavāhi yādisā Khujjuttarā ca upāsikā Veḷukaṇḍakiyā ca Nandamātāti || || 4
sn17.24:1.5: Esā bhikkhave tulā etam pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānam upāsikānam yadidam Khujjuttarā ca upāsikā Veḷukaṇḍakiyā ca Nandamātā || || 5
sn17.24:1.6: Sa ce kho tvam ayye agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajasi ||
sn17.24:1.7: tādisā āyye bhavāhi yādisā Khemā ca bhikkhunī Uppalavaṇṇā cāti || || 6
sn17.24:1.8: Esā bhikkhave tulā etam pamāṇaṃ mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yadidaṃ Khemā ca bhikkhunī Uppalavaṇṇā ca || 7
sn17.24:1.9: Mā ca kho tvam ayye sekham appamattamānasam lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātūti || || 8
sn17.24:1.10: Taṃ ce bhikkhave bhikkhuniṃ sekham appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇāti || so tassā hoti antarāyāya || 9
sn17.24:1.11: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || 10
